text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find Hishi Amazon back in the waiting
room
after the race. She's completely
silent...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What're you talkin' to me like I'm fragile glass for? How do I look to you right now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Depressed 'cause I lost? Like I'll never
bounce
back from this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Depressed 'cause I lost? Like I'll never
bounce
back from this?

choice_data_list_en: Those are eyes looking to the future.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, you know your stuff. And it's not
just that. I
also feel happy...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea there were so many
formidable
racers just waitin' for me to
trounce 'em!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna take 'em on and beat 'em all!
This is
enough to motivate me to train
till the cows come
home, and then some!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's clear what I have to do, and that's
getting
even faster!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get stronger! And once I do,
I'm takin'
everyone down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I can do this, Teach! I'm gonna train lots
and grab
that win for sure!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Stop making that sad face! Gettin' all
down in the
dumps isn't gonna help
things!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've got plenty of energy to pull through!
I'll never
give up, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You'd better not tell me to cool my
heels or
anything, 'cause I'm bringing
this heat to the next
race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not about to let things end here! I'm
Hishi
Amazon, Queen of the Amazons,
and I'm not
goin' anywhere!
